_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Twenty-two individually named people across six original-language official court/prosecutor case pages in Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines. Court findings, first-instance sentences, and report dates remain separate. Country markers mean historical person-specific case conduct only; no precise/live locations, inferred foreign-country operation, photos, or pairwise edges. Two additional Điện Biên names were excluded because the prosecutor article repeats one defendant in its verdict list and leaves another outcome unclear. Later appeals after these sources were not verified.
